title: Kaguya GRS Nuclide Map (1° grid)
description: Elemental/oxide abundance values (Ca as CaO, K, Th, U) at 1° bin size (~30 km), derived from the Kaguya (SELENE) Gamma Ray Spectrometer. JAXA classifies the Nuclide Map as a 'Higher Level' product, i.e. a further-processed elemental abundance map built on top of the Standard-level Gamma Ray Intensity (count-rate) Map. These are the four Nuclide Map elements JAXA has made publicly available; Al, Fe, Mg, O, Si, and Ti nuclide maps referenced in the JAXA GRS format spec were not released. Values in wt% for CaO; ppm for K, Th, U.

providers.name: DARTS, Institute of Space and Astronautical Science (ISAS/JAXA)
